body: Video-note false error: history-drain PendingAudit treats in-flight sending rows (no draft while upload runs on global queue) as stranded and writes status=error. Engine sendMessage returns state=sending; handleNativeVideoNoteSend drops that because 'sending' is not in its allow-list and paints sent. Fix: audit only pending, skip activeMediaUploadTasks, keep sending.
author: Vibe Team
